<function name="SetExpensiveShadow" parent="Panel" type="classfunc">
	<description>Adds a shadow falling to the bottom right corner of the panel's text.

<note>This works only on  panels that derive from <page>Label</page>.</note>
</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="distance" type="number">The distance of the shadow from the panel.</arg>
		<arg name="Color" type="Color">The color of the shadow. Uses <page>Color</page>.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
